title: Baylan Skoll
description: Baylan Skoll is a Lightsaber-wielding mercenary for hire overseeing his apprentice, Shin Hati. Although there was a time when Skoll knew the acclaimed Jedi Knight Anakin Skywalker, Baylan is no Jedi. Now allied with Morgan Elsbeth, the former Magistrate of Calodan, after the fall of Jedi and the Empire, Skoll remains a shrewd fighter in search of power, believing that another war is inevitable.
